basic_details.job_title: ESIC MCH Bihta Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 59 Professor, Associate & Assistant Professor Posts
basic_details.short_information: Employees' State Insurance Corporation - ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Bihta, Patna (ESIC MCH Bihta), Bihar, has invited applications for 59 posts in 3 roles under Advt No. 15 of 2026. The posts include Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor. Applications go by email to [email protected] and must be sent by 18 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Demand Draft in favor of ESIC HOSPITAL BIHTA SB ACC- 2, payable at Bihta, Patna. SBI Branch Code- 01217.

qualification.education_qualification: As per NMC (MCI) guidelines. Updated NMC / State Medical Council registration required.

salary_details.pay_scale: Fixed Basic: Professor Rs. 1,18,500; Associate Professor Rs. 78,800; Assistant Professor Rs. 67,700, plus other allowance

how_to_apply: Prepare the application in the prescribed format, separately for each post, with self-attested copies of the listed documents.
Email the scanned copy of the application form with supporting documents to [email protected] by 12:00 Noon of 18.11.2026.

On the date of interview submit the original application form, supporting documents and the original Demand Draft (interview fee, if applicable) to The Dean, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Bihta, Patna- 801103.
Report for the offline interview on the scheduled date and time with the required documents.
important_instructions: Vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease. Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview or submitting any document.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Monthly pay is paid according to data in the Biometric Attendance System for attendance marked by the person. Tenure 01 (One) year OR attainment of 70 years of age, whichever is earlier. Engagement may be terminated from either side with one-month prior notice without assigning reason. On spot resignation, one month's salary is to be deposited to ESIC Account through Challan. No claim for PF, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Allowance/Benefits, Seniority, Promotion etc. Absence beyond 07 days without permission amounts to voluntary abandonment and automatic termination. Attendance to be marked manually and on AEBAS daily; monthly pay as per Biometric Attendance System data.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ESIC MCH Bihta Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ESIC MCH Bihta Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 59 vacancies: 16 Professor, 26 Associate Professor, 17 Assistant Professor.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ESIC MCH Bihta Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 18 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: SC / ST / Female / ESIC (Regular Employee) / Defence Ex-Servicemen / PH Candidate: Nil. All other categories: Rs. 500.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 69 years (as on 18 November 2026).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Fixed Basic- ₹ 1,18,500 & other allowance for Professor, Fixed Basic- ₹ 78,800 & other allowance for Associate Professor, Fixed Basic- ₹ 67,700 & other allowance for Assistant Professor.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per NMC (MCI) guidelines. Updated NMC / State Medical Council registration required. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates working in Govt./Autonomous/Statutory institutions should preferably bring an NOC, or a copy of 'applied for NOC', at the interview. No private practice is allowed in any capacity after joining. Retired/Working Professor may apply to vacant post of Associate Professor; salary as per the scale of Professor.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Academic credentials. Interview before the Selection Board. Selection is on the basis of acquired academic credentials and performance in interview before the Selection Board. Result will be displayed on www.mcpatna.esic.gov.in and www.esic.gov.in; offer of appointment will be sent by email.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Tenure 01 (One) year OR attainment of 70 years of age, whichever is earlier. Engagement may be terminated from either side with one-month prior notice without assigning reason. On spot resignation, one month's salary is to be deposited to ESIC Account through Challan.
